scientific_question: Does first-40-calibrated metric distance add closed-loop Revisit utility beyond CEC's verified bearing when all other runtime components are fixed?
claim_boundary: consumed-population promotion gate; not fresh confirmation or certified metric safety

population.history: actual causal full-monocular NavDP Goal-A replay

full_metric.support_cap_source: frozen NavDP native PointGoal preprocessing envelope

decision.promote: paired net gain >= 2 and losses <= 1 and zero 10m support-cap hits
decision.support_saturation: any 10m support-cap hit stops the branch and retains fixed 2.5m
decision.otherwise: keep fixed 2.5m; efficiency-only retention requires >=10% paired both-success path or step improvement with zero losses and zero support-cap hits

forbidden: Novel or Revisit label as runtime input
